newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end down, technicals point lower.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end down, technicals point lower.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended weaker as the most-active January contract again failed to hold above resistance at psychologically-key 100.00.
Analysts blame losses on weak technical indicators, citing today's close near the day's lows coupled with high open interest of 4,742 in the spot November contract.
Near-term support in January was pegged at 98.00 with firmer support seen at 95.00.
The fundamental outlook is also bearish, analysts said. "Weighing on the back months is the prospect for larger supplies and lower demand," an analyst said.
She said players await delivery notices Monday.
"A large number could have a negative initial impact on prices," she said.
The most-active January contract closed down 0.60 at 99.20, having ranged froom 100.20 to 99.10, barely above the contract low of 99.00.
The back months finished 1.15 to 0.55 lower.
